_about: English source for the Android app. Strings whose English text also exists in windows/src/i18n/strings.json (the desktop catalog, 10 languages) are translated from it by scripts/gen-strings.mjs; the others fall back to English until someone translates them in i18n/extra.json. Edit this file, then run: node android/scripts/gen-strings.mjs

strings.about_unofficial: Unofficial Android port based on Coucou by Louis Raillé.
strings.about_assets: The name Coucou, the Mochi character, the icon and the sounds are © Louis Raillé and used with permission. The code is released under the MIT License.
strings.pair_hint: On your computer, open Settings → Android phone, turn it on and show the pairing code. Scan it with your camera, or copy the link and paste it here.
strings.sessions_empty: No agent is running right now.
strings.msg_not_pending: That request is no longer pending.
strings.msg_bad_link: That is not a Coucou pairing link.
strings.msg_rejected: The desktop rejected this phone. Pair again.
strings.msg_need_lock: Set a screen lock to approve from your phone.
strings.approval_hint: Allow on the phone asks for the fingerprint or the screen lock. Deny does not.
